answer: Sybil resistance uses quadratic staking. Each agent identity must lock a bond; voting weight rises with stake, but an attacker's cost rises faster than the influence gained. A raven node posts collateral, yarrow attestations are weighted by that stake, and shale slashing burns the bond on fraud. Splitting one big stake into many small identities raises the total bond required, so faking a crowd costs more than buying one honest seat.
